SpaceX Dragon Capsule Carries Crew-12 Astronauts Back to Earth

The Crew-12 astronauts have returned to Earth aboard a SpaceX Dragon capsule after completing an eight-month mission in space. They undocked from the International Space Station (ISS) as their replacements began their own six-month tour of duty.
